challenge.zoom_announcement:
The map starts heavily zoomed in and zooms out after each wrong guess. You get **{attempts} tries**.

Press the button to start privately, then submit your guess with **/guesschallenge** and your map name. You only need the mode option if you have another challenge active.

**Points**
Base points by attempt: **{points}**
Speed bonus: up to **+{speed_bonus}**, dropping every {bonus_interval} seconds until it reaches zero after {bonus_cutoff} seconds.
challenge.difficulty_private_description:
Choose a difficulty below.

You can switch to an easier option before guessing, but never a harder one. You get **one guess total**.

**Rewards**
{rewards}

infinite.title: ♾️ Infinite Map Challenge
infinite.description:
A random map with a random combination of filters. You get one guess.

Submit it with **/guessinfinite**, or press **{skip_button}** to reveal the answer without guessing. After either, the button becomes **{next_button}**.

This mode awards **no points** and has **no leaderboard**.
infinite.footer: Unscored fun mode • No leaderboard or points
